You also commented about this in hdfs bug #2 and opened #4. In how many ways do you intend to submit the same problem? I can pull out the fax machine if you need me to. Thanks

The code:

data=to.dfs(1:10)
res = mapreduce(input = data, map = function(k, v) cbind(v, 2*v))

And then....
